records.source: A word touching ``_`` or a digit is a piece of an identifier -- ``cell_area``, ``channel_1``, ``image_path`` -- and not a word of prose. Translating it rewrites a column name, a settings key or an SQL example into something that no longer names anything: the database browser's own example predicate, ``cell_area > 1000``, was shown to a Swedish user as ``Cell_area > 1000``, and the search hint offered ``'Kanal_1'`` for a column called ``channel_1``.
